subject: math

objective.text: Count by fives on a number line and on a clock to tell time to the nearest 5 minutes.

explanations.title: From tape to number line
explanations.text: A tape of 12 units of 5 minutes is 60 minutes. Draw a line below it with tick marks where the units meet.

explanations.title: Intervals of 5 minutes
explanations.text: The space between two tick marks is an interval. Here each interval is 5 minutes. Count 0, 5, 10, up to 60.

explanations.title: Time is continuous
explanations.text: Time was going before we start and keeps going after. So the number line has arrows on both ends.

explanations.title: A clock is a number line in a circle
explanations.text: We count by fives on both. A clock is like a number line wrapped in a circle. It starts at 12, not 0.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Parts 2-3 (S: The clock is like the number line wrapped in a circle.)

examples.title: Plot 1:10 p.m.
examples.text: Start at 1:00. Count two 5-minute intervals: 5, 10. Draw a dot there. That point shows 1:10 p.m.

examples.title: 4 problems
examples.text: Each problem takes 5 minutes. Hop 5, 10, 15, 20. 4 problems take 20 minutes.

questions.text: Count by eights: 16, 24, 32. What number comes next?
Count by 5 minutes. How many minutes are in a quarter hour?

source_ref.section: Fluency: Minute Counting (count to the quarter hour)

questions.text: Christine has 12 math problems. Each takes 5 minutes. How many minutes does she need for all 12?
On a number line counted by fives, how many minutes are from 15 to 30?
Each problem takes 5 minutes. Use the number line. How long do 7 problems take?
A 12-centimeter number line shows 60 minutes. How many 5-minute intervals does it need?
The number line runs from 1:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m. How many 5-minute intervals from 1:00 to 1:35?
How many 5-minute intervals show 15 minutes on a clock?
A clock has no 0. Where do you start counting minutes on a clock?
Ingrid's number line goes from 7:00 to 8:00 a.m. How many 5-minute intervals after 7:00 is 7:40?

Math class starts at 10:00 a.m. and ends at 11:00 a.m. How long is math class?
The clock shows 1 to 12. The number line shows 0 to 60. What do these labels stand for?
